title: IIM Lucknow Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
summary: The Indian Institute of Management Lucknow is hiring for the position of Manager (Security) on a contract basis. The role requires an Ex-Serviceman with a Post Graduate/MBA degree and relevant experience. Candidates must apply online through a Google Form by 07 December 2026.
qualification: Post Graduate/MBA with minimum 60% marks and 5 years of relevant experience, including 2 years in a managerial capacity. Must be an Ex-Serviceman retired or voluntarily retired at the rank of Major or equivalent.
summary_hindi: भारतीय प्रबंधन संस्थान लखनऊ अनुबंध के आधार पर प्रबंधक (सुरक्षा) के पद के लिए भर्ती कर रहा है। इस भूमिका के लिए एक पूर्व सैनिक की आवश्यकता है जिसके पास पोस्ट ग्रेजुएट / MBA डिग्री और संबंधित अनुभव होना चाहिए। उम्मीदवारों को 07 दिसंबर 2026 तक गूगल फॉर्म के माध्यम से ऑनलाइन आवेदन करना होगा।
how_to_apply: Visit the Google Form link provided in the official notification.
Enter a valid email ID for all communications.
Fill in the required details accurately, ensuring to include your exact percentage of marks.
Attach any necessary certificates for age relaxation if applicable.
Submit the form before the deadline of 07 December 2026.
overview: The Manager (Security) position at IIM Lucknow involves overseeing security operations at the institute. It is suited for Ex-Servicemen who have a strong background in leadership and security management.

This contractual role, initially lasting three years but subject to extension, offers a competitive salary package. It emphasizes the importance of security management in educational institutions, particularly in light of evolving security needs.

Applicants should ensure they meet the eligibility criteria and check the official notification for meticulous details regarding qualifications and the selection process. This position not only offers a chance to contribute to a prestigious institution but also fits well for those looking to transition into corporate roles post-service.
about_organization: The Indian Institute of Management Lucknow is a premier business school in India, offering management education and conducting research. It aims to provide leadership in management education and contribute to societal development through education and research.
eligibility_notes: Candidates must be Indian citizens and Ex-Servicemen with the required educational qualifications and experience. There are relaxations available for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates in age limit and the role encourages applications from women candidates.
preparation_tips: Review the key security management concepts that apply to educational institutions.
Familiarize yourself with the selection process, particularly the types of tests and interviews that may be conducted.
Practice interview skills focusing on security management scenarios, and prepare to discuss your relevant experience in depth.
Stay updated on current affairs related to security and defense, which could be pertinent during the selection process.

faq.q: How many Manager (Security) vacancies are there at IIM Lucknow?
faq.a: There is 01 position of Manager (Security) under Advt. No. IIML/Rectt.-10C/2026.

faq.q: What is the last date to apply for IIM Lucknow Manager (Security)?
faq.a: The last date is 07.12.2026. Applications must be submitted through the Google Form on or before that date.

faq.q: What is the qualification for IIM Lucknow Manager (Security)?
faq.a: The candidate must be an Ex-Serviceman, retired or voluntarily retired, not below the rank of Major or equivalent, and hold a Post Graduate/MBA in regular mode with minimum 60% marks.

faq.q: What is the age limit for the IIM Lucknow Manager (Security) post?
faq.a: The upper age limit is 40 years, counted as on the closing date for receipt of applications.

faq.q: What is the salary of IIM Lucknow Manager (Security)?
faq.a: The monthly consolidated emoluments are ₹ 92,000 plus fixed HRA of ₹ 10,620, totaling ₹ 1,02,620.

title: IIM Lucknow Yoga Instructor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
summary: IIM Lucknow is recruiting a Yoga Instructor (Part-Time) on a contract basis for an initial period of three years. Candidates must have relevant qualifications and a minimum of 10 years of experience. Applications are to be submitted online by December 7, 2026.
qualification: Graduation in Yoga from a recognized Institution/University, or Graduation in any discipline plus a Diploma in Yoga of at least one year's duration from a recognized University/Institution.

how_to_apply: Open the Google Form link provided in the notification.
Fill in the application form before the deadline of December 7, 2026.
Enter a valid email ID for communication regarding the selection process.
Attach necessary certificates for any claims of age relaxation.
Submit the application only once final, as modifications won't be entertained.

preparation_tips: Review the latest trends and practices in Yoga to be prepared for skill assessment.

faq.q: How many Yoga Instructor posts has IIM Lucknow advertised?

faq.q: What is the last date to apply for IIM Lucknow Yoga Instructor?

title: IIML Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Junior Manager, Junior Programme Assistant Posts
